recipes.name: Carol's Beet & Acorn Cookies (feat. Ashwin Enjoys Nature)
instructions: Puree the can of beets in a high powered blender. Puree the water chestnuts in a blender (separately) as well. Process the cacao nibs with a mortar and pestle. - 1 can of sliced beets - 1 can of water chestnuts - 3 tbsp of cacao nibs

In a bowl, add beet puree, melted coconut oil, vanilla paste, brown sugar, and a splash of pureed water chestnuts. Whisk to combine. - ¼ cup of coconut oil - ¼ cup brown sugar - ½ tsp of vanilla paste

In the bowl of a stand mixer, combine the acorn flour, the all purpose flour, processed cacao nibs, and arrowroot powder. Mix briefly on medium speed and then add the wet ingredients. Next, add the chocolate chips as the stand mixer continues to mix. - ¾ cup acorn flour - ¾ cup all purpose flour - 2 tbsp of arrowroot powder - ½ cup of chocolate chips
Then, realize you're still missing something and add egg and sugar to the mix. Beat to combine. - 1 egg - ⅓ cup sugar
Roll dough into 2 inch balls and roll in confectioners sugar. - Confectioners sugar
Arrange on a lightly greased cookie sheet and bake at 350°F for 15 minutes.
